narr: The series of atmospheric rivers continued across Southern California in early January of 2023. Widespread rain and high-elevation snow occurred, leading to several instances of rock and mud slides, as well as a swiftwater rescue near Palm Springs. Very high surf and coastal flooding occurred across Orange and San Diego County Beaches.
ev: Swiftwater rescue of two vehicles stuck in wash on North Indian Canyon Drive near Sunrise Parkway. Whitewater and Morongo Canyon (Whitewater Trout Farm) and Lower Snow Creek received 0.5-1 inch from 6am-12pm. Video of vehicles in lower water crossing submerged in flowing water.
